snippet.title: The Sinking City 2 Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825860/The_Sinking_City_2/

Lovecraftian survival horror adventure The Sinking City 2 is out now on PC, PlayStation and Xbox — but it's also coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027, as revealed during the Future Games Show at gamescom.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
